what_this_is: How a page keeps a live room open (src/workspace/live-room.ts): how long a change waits for the room to say it kept it, how soon a dropped connection opens again, and the words a change that was not kept says. A room is any shared store the Worker opens as a records socket (src/board-room.mjs): a pursuit's board and every record placed in that pursuit (src/workspace/record-places.json).

words.not_kept: The connection dropped before that change was kept. It reconnects by itself; make the change again.
